verdict.rationale: The axis applies to a cloud platform. The only on-topic evidence is that deleting a CloudFormation stack deletes all of its resources, which gives coarse, infrastructure-level deletion. Nothing in the pack documents data-retention controls such as retention periods, lifecycle policies or log/backup expiry, or how Bedrock/AgentCore handles prompt and agent data. Missing for 10: documented data-retention policy controls, object/log lifecycle and expiry settings, AI-service data-retention and deletion guarantees, independent or hands-on corroboration.
